_comment: Routing and dependency gates for the native AI platform OS implementation plan.
This file declares INTENT: who is assigned what, and what blocks what.
It never declares STATE. State is derived from git by scripts/task_status.py,
because a hand-maintained status table is how this repository accumulated eight
claim-defects. If this file and git disagree, git is right.
glm-5.3-flash  volume implementation once a task is expanded to step form
minimax-m3     all UI/UX surfaces, built against contract fixtures
opus           correctness-critical: adversarial design, judgment, review gate
human          requires hardware, a credential, or a machine nobody has run
branch_convention_note: Advisory only. The tracker matches any branch containing task-{id} as a segment, so feat/task-0.1-reputation-workspace, impl/task-0.1 and fix/task-0.1-x all resolve to the same task. The plan is authoritative on the exact name.

0.4.note: Task 0.4 lints tier disclosure across report, status AND console. Phase 4 owns the console coverage surface (L8-13). Landing 0.4 first fixes the only file-domain collision between the GLM and MiniMax lanes.

routing_notes.1.1: Keystone. Evidence and notary into the report path; everything in Phases 1-2 is meaningless until it lands. Review hardest.
routing_notes.1.5: One delegation algebra. Merging two implementations of one contract is a correctness decision, not volume work.
routing_notes.2.1: The effect decomposition registry is the architectural keystone of the syscall model. A wrong decomposition silently under-governs an effect.
routing_notes.3.2: Needs a TPM or an OS keystore observed executing. macOS has never been installed or launched in this project.
routing_notes.5.3: Do not delegate to a fast model. The value is an adversary that genuinely tries; one that fails trivially yields a green result and a false guarantee.
routing_notes.5.4: The drills are mechanical; naming shared failure domains is judgment.

minimax_phase_4.build_against: contract fixtures, not a running backend
minimax_phase_4.note: Phase 4 sits after Phase 3 in the spine, but contracts-first decouples it: the UI is built against frozen fixtures so the lanes run parallel.
